meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能操控浏览器,例如打开网页、点击元素、填写表单、滚动页面、截图、录屏、读取页面信息。它会先抓取页面上可交互元素并编号(如 @e1),再用编号执行操作。
howto.when: 当用户需要浏览网站、与网页交互、填写表单等涉及网页的操作时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com 并截图保存
say.note: 会打开页面并保存截图

say.text: 在搜索框输入‘天气’并点击搜索按钮
say.note: 会用快照编号定位输入框和按钮

say.text: 读取当前页面的标题和网址
say.note: 返回页面标题和当前链接

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude drive a browser: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, scroll, take screenshots, record video, and read page content. It first snapshots the page to get element refs like @e1, then interacts using those refs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user needs to browse websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, or perform other browser-related tasks such as screenshots, testing, or extracting page info.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Opens the page and saves a screenshot

say_en.text: Type 'weather' in the search box and click the search button
say_en.note: Locates the input and button via snapshot refs

say_en.text: Get the current page title and URL
say_en.note: Returns the title and current link
